result.title: How Many Ranks Does a Token Need? A Noise-Floor Squelch for Rank-One LoRA Experts
result.summary: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) applies every rank-one component of its update to every token, and mixture-of-experts variants replace this with a learned router that activates a fixed number of components. We argue that the number of components a token needs is a detection question with a classical answer. A token's responses to the rank-one components of a trained LoRA consist of a few large values on a Gaussian noise floor whose width matches that of an untrained adapter, and the floor carries cross-talk rather than adaptation. We introduce SQUELCH, a router-free mixture of rank-one experts that (i) soft-thresholds each token's responses at a multiple of its own robust noise level, so the active rank varies per token; (ii) chooses that multiple for each module by Stein's unbiased risk estimate, so no rank budget is specified; and (iii) replaces the resulting marginal keep-or-drop decisions by one explaining-away step on the value Gram matrix, which suppresses redundant co-active components and recruits complementary ones. SQUELCH adds no trainable parameters to LoRA. We prove that the squelch is within a logarithmic factor of the oracle input-dependent allocation, that the selected threshold is risk-consistent, and that explaining away is a descent step toward the joint sparse code whose error is controlled by the coherence of co-active components. On commonsense reasoning, knowledge, math, code, and GLUE with LLaMA-3.1-8B, Qwen3, and DeBERTaV3, SQUELCH improves over LoRA by 2.2--3.2 points and over the strongest mixture baseline by 0.8--1.2 points while activating 8.6 of 32 components per token on average.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SQUELCH：一种无路由器的秩一 LoRA 专家混合，按每 token 自身稳健噪声水平对响应做软阈值，使激活秩随 token 变化，并用 Stein 无偏风险估计选阈值、用 value Gram 矩阵上的 explaining-away 抑制冗余激活，附有 oracle 分配与风险一致性证明，在多任务上超过 LoRA 与最强混合基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文的「按 token 自适应决定激活多少组件」与 explaining-away 抑制冗余、招募互补分量，可能为 LVR 的动态计算/停止决策与 latent 分量筛选提供可核查线索，但它属纯文本 PEFT，与视觉推理无直接联系，迁移需自行验证。
